changelog: Added a Reset Inventory button (Setup tab) that wipes active cars for a clean re-scan while keeping Sold/Delivered records. Fixed the D2C list-scan hang (now opens Snake's Hustle reliably via the background). Builds on 3.9.0: posted tracking, Facebook scout/relist, D2C whole-list import, days-on-lot + under-25 flag, sort by days, and a last-scan timestamp.
